where: Taxonomy > Family Dictynidae O. Pickard-Cambridge, 1871 (卷叶蛛科) > Subfamily Dictyninae O. Pickard-Cambridge, 1871 (卷叶蛛亚科) > Genus Sudesna Lehtinen, 1967 > Sudesna wangi sp. nov. > Description > Female paratype
quote: Eye sizes and interdistances: AME 0.04, ALE 0.05, PME 0.05, PLE, 0.05; AME–AME 0.08, AME–ALE 0.10, PME–PME 0.11, PME–PLE 0.15, ALE–PLE 0.03.
note: New trait key eye_diameter_mm as on main (desk-d385 Sudesna of the same paper): the Materials and methods print 'Eye sizes were measured as the maximum dorsal diameter.' and 'All measurements are in millimetres.', and the quoted sentence prints the label 'Eye sizes'. Value is the figure printed after this record's own label (ALE); interdistances, MOA and the other eyes are not in this record. Sex: female. The page prints 'PLE, 0.05' with a comma after PLE and the quote keeps it. Same paper as desk-d385's Sudesna chayu, S. mii, S. medog, S. flavipes and S. linzhiensis; desk-d385 left S. wangi out because its excerpt was cut off in the eye line and before the female, and flagged the paratype-code duplication. Audit 889 replaced where (Chinese names in the printed Family and Subfamily headings), the licence sentence (now as printed), and conditions. New trait key eye_diameter_mm as already used on main (e.g. desk-d280).

method: measurement under a Leica M205A stereomicroscope as listed in the Description sentence 'Eye sizes and interdistances'; Methods: 'Eye sizes were measured as the maximum dorsal diameter.'
conditions: Female paratype SWUC-T-DI-23-02 of Sudesna wangi sp. nov., the specimen measured as named by the Description run-in label 'Female paratype (SWUC-T-DI-23-02, Fig. 12B) total length 2.50.'; that code is not in the printed paratype range (see below), which the page does not resolve. Type material as printed: 'Holotype: ♂ (SWUC-T-DI-23-01) • China, Xizang, Nyingchi City, Chayu County, Cibagou National Nature Reserve,' + ' 28°36'01"N, 97°04'00", elev. 1995 m, 22.06.2023, C. Wang leg.' (no E after the longitude as returned); 'Paratypes: • 1 ♂ 1 ♀ (SWUC-T-DI-21-02 to 03), same data as holotype.' The female run-in label in the Description prints 'Female paratype (SWUC-T-DI-23-02, Fig. 12B) total length 2.50.' The two printings disagree (21-02 to 03 in the paratype line, 23-02 in the Description label); the range 21-02 to 04 is also printed for S. mii paratypes (desk-d385 on main). WSC spec-data/73643 lists holotype 'm (T-DI-23-01)' and paratypes '1m 1f (T-DI-23 02-03)', SWUC. Female Description sentences in printed order: 'Female paratype (SWUC-T-DI-23-02, Fig. 12B) total length 2.50.'; 'Prosoma 1.00 long, 0.91 wide; opisthosoma 1.58 long, 1.09 wide.'; the quoted eye sentence (returned in two consecutive pieces, rejoined; printed as one sentence); 'MOA 0.16 long, anterior width 0.17, posterior width 0.18.'; 'Clypeus height 0.14.'; 'Legs yellowish, with black pigmentation.'; leg measurements; Epigyne begins 'Copulatory openings large, 9-shaped, facing away from each other, separated about 3 times their width.' Materials and methods, read whole (8 sentences); the eye passage is 'Eye sizes were measured as the maximum dorsal diameter.' and the unit sentence 'All measurements are in millimetres.'; the abbreviation list prints 'ALE, anterior lateral eye; AME, anterior median eye;' and '… PLE, posterior lateral eye; PME, posterior median eye;'. Licence, printed on the publisher article preview page read (sentence returned in three consecutive pieces, rejoined): 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Publisher's own free full text. World Spider Catalog spec-data/73643 (opened from my own search results): 'Sudesna wangi Wang, Zhang & Xu, 2026', ACCEPTED, 'Genus: Sudesna Lehtinen, 1967', 'Family: Dictynidae O. Pickard-Cambridge, 1871', original description at '296, f. 11A-E, 12A-G (Dmf)'; the paper's family (Dictynidae) and WSC's agree. Not on main: git grep of origin/main docs/ for 'Sudesna wangi' and for '187037' (any trait) finds only desk-d385 (other Sudesna species of this paper; its progress file says S. wangi was not filed) and a desk-d443 note listing the DOI against desk-d385.
